review_comments: We should also check every usage of `childResult`, and wrap them with `if e.childResult != nil`.
I don't think we should check at every usage, because if open returned error, only Close will be called.
Becaue at the end of this Close, there is a `e.memTracker.ReplaceBytesUsed(0)`, so there is really no reason to reduce them here.
@ichn-hu Well, IMO, it looks more resonable to remove `e.memTracker.ReplaceBytesUsed(0)` instead that can help to track memory leak...

For my part, if this modification is aimed to enhance the memory track of `agg.memTracker`, we'd better open another issue or PR to track it.
This modification has nothing to do with the issue that this PR wants to fix.
